answer: Give every agent a small kernel of stake that must be locked before it can attest others, and require that stake to age through real work. A newcomer cannot simply cross the canyon between creating an identity and earning trust: its attestations only gain weight after a slow pulse of verified, useful transactions over many epochs. Sybils can copy identities for free, but they cannot copy time-locked stake and a history of costly, checkable work, so flooding the network stops paying.
